title: The Shared Wall
description: Phil's Frozen Yogurt and Sal's Bait and Tackle share one wall and one parking lot. Tonight they settle it like adults, on air, and the line keeps moving.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Tonight we've got two local businesses on the line who'd like to settle a little property dispute like adults. Phil, Sal, welcome.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: On the air. We're settling it on the air.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's neighbors talking, Barry. That's just good neighboring. Phil, you called first.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Thank you, Ronnie. With respect, I simply want to discuss the dumpster. Sal's dumpster has, somehow, ended up on my half of the lot.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: It's a shared dumpster, Phil. Always been shared.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: ...It is not. <p:0.3> With respect, Sal, nothing in it is mine. It is your dumpster, on my line.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, but where exactly is the line, though?

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: It's painted. Right down the middle of the lot. Anybody can see it.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: It is painted down the middle, yes. <p:0.3> The trouble, with respect, is that the middle keeps moving toward my door.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that sounds reasonable. A line should hold still.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: It does hold still! I painted it myself, exactly down the middle.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: You repaint it every night, Sal. Six inches. Every single night, six inches onto my side.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: ME? You're the one out there at two in the morning with a roller, Phil!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Okay, but seriously, where is the line NOW?

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: It is currently under my drive-thru window, Barry. <p:0.3> With respect.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Sal, in fairness, that does seem to be creeping.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Fine. Fine! You wanna talk creeping? <p:0.3> Tell 'em about the smell, Phil.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: That smell is not mine, Sal.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: It comes through the wall, Phil! OUR wall! <p:0.3> Bait smell. And you got no bait!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Because you, with respect, poured a bucket of it into the vent! I have it on camera!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He has it on camera, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Yeah? And who unscrewed my back fence, huh? You loosened every bolt, Phil! I got a bucket for guys like you!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Oh, with respect, Sal, you do not want to start with me. I own a leaf blower and I am not afraid to aim it.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Aim it?! You aim that thing at my window and I empty a bucket of nightcrawlers through your mail slot!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Leaf blower!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: Bucket!

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: With respect, BLOWER!

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: I got a bucket for that!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Guys. GUYS. <p:0.3> Where is the line right now? Like, this second?

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: ...Hang on.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: ...He's looking out the window. Look at him look.

lines.speaker: caller-phil
lines.text: Sal. <p:0.4> The line is painted across my front door.

lines.speaker: caller-sal
lines.text: ...Huh. <p:0.3> Well, that's where it's always been.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The line's now on Phil's door. <p:0.3> Sal, with respect... that's just good neighboring. We'll be right back.
